routing_contract.when_to_use: Use when running the weekly organic-social measurement loop: building or applying the metric dictionary (declared, period-locked denominators on every reported rate), rolling up per-post performance with medians and an organic/boosted split, translating results to EMV for executives (labeled, never scored), running the attributed CHAOSS/Orbit-style community-health readout on an owned community, or compiling the best/worst-performer write-back for the next calendar cycle. Not the dollar-ROI math (roi-calculator) and never the ECHO profile result verdict (social-quality-auditor).
